description: Implement the lexer/tokenizer for the vek language. Handles all token types defined in the language spec: keywords, identifiers, literals (int, float, string with interpolation, symbol), operators, punctuation, and block delimiters (do/end).
steps: Create /projects/sandbox/vek/src/lexer.h defining the Token struct (type, start pointer, length, line number) and TokenType enum covering: single-char tokens (( ) [ ] { } , . ; : + - * / % & | ^ ~ < > = !), multi-char tokens (== != <= >= && || .. ... -> => ?. ?: << >>), literals (TOKEN_INT, TOKEN_FLOAT, TOKEN_STRING, TOKEN_SYMBOL, TOKEN_IDENTIFIER), keywords (fn, end, do, if, elsif, else, while, until, loop, for, in, case, return, break, next, true, false, nil, and, or, not, begin, rescue, raise, get, post, put, patch, delete, render, redirect, halt, require_login), and TOKEN_EOF, TOKEN_ERROR, TOKEN_NEWLINE.

Create /projects/sandbox/vek/src/lexer.c implementing: lexer_init(source), lexer_next_token() with a switch-based scanner. Handle: skipping whitespace and comments (# to end of line), single-char tokens, multi-char operators (peek ahead for ==, !=, etc), integer literals (with _ separators like 50_000), float literals (with decimal point and optional e notation), string literals (single and double quotes, with #{} interpolation detection for double-quoted strings), symbol literals (:identifier), identifiers and keyword lookup (use a trie or sorted array for keyword matching).

Create /projects/sandbox/vek/tests/test_lexer.c with comprehensive tests: basic tokens (operators, punctuation), keywords vs identifiers, integer literals (plain, with underscores, negative), float literals, string literals (both quote styles), symbol literals, string interpolation tokens, comments being skipped, multi-line input with line tracking, error tokens for unterminated strings.
Ensure lexer handles edge cases: consecutive operators (a+-b), range operators (.. vs ...), safe navigation (?. vs ? :), arrow (-> vs - >), the distinction between unary minus and subtraction.
acceptance_criteria: Lexer correctly tokenizes all vek operators and punctuation
Lexer correctly identifies all keywords and distinguishes them from identifiers
Lexer handles integer literals with underscore separators (50_000 -> 50000)
Lexer handles string literals with both quote styles and detects interpolation boundaries
Lexer produces symbol tokens for :identifier syntax
Lexer tracks line numbers correctly across multi-line input
Lexer produces TOKEN_ERROR for malformed input (unterminated strings, invalid chars)
verification: Run 'make test' and confirm all lexer tests pass
findings: Lexer implemented and all 31 tests pass. Key design notes: (1) Identifier trailing ? is not consumed when followed by . or : to allow ?. safe-nav and ?: ternary. (2) String interpolation emits TOKEN_INTERPOLATION_START when #{ is encountered in double-quoted strings; the parser will need a state stack to track interpolation context for proper string reconstruction. (3) TOKEN_NEWLINE is emitted on the line where the newline occurs (before incrementing line counter). (4) Single-quoted strings do not support interpolation. (5) The lexer uses a linear keyword lookup; can be optimized to a trie if performance becomes an issue.
